chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him), meaning az-Zubayr, at a time for which it was appropriate [and he invited him to enter into the allegiance a second time].

key_terms.الزُّبَيْر: Az-Zubayr ibn al-Awwam, a prominent companion and rival of Imam Ali.
key_terms.الْبَيْعَةِ: The pledge of allegiance, a formal act of accepting leadership or authority.
key_terms.حَالٍ: A situation, state, or time appropriate for a specific action.

ai.seo_question: What was Imam Ali's interaction with az-Zubayr regarding his allegiance?
ai.summary: This narration highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) strategic patience and diplomatic approach toward Az-Zubayr, inviting him to renew his bay'ah during a critical period of political consolidation. It reflects the Shia scholarly view of Ali’s legitimacy and his efforts to unify the Muslim community through reasoned invitation rather than immediate force, emphasizing the importance of timely action ('when circumstances warranted it').
